jams_hub_description: Themed, time-boxed competitions where the community builds new Sons of the Forest mods and votes for the best ones.
jams_hub_intro: Build in days, vote in a week, earn badges. Every jam has a theme, a deadline and four voting categories.
jams_empty_text: The next Mod Jam will be announced here. Follow the site to hear about it first.
jams_theme_hidden: The theme is a secret until submissions open.
jams_detail_description_fallback: {title}: a Sons of the Forest Mod Jam. See the theme, the entries and the results.
jams_guest_hint: Sign in to submit an entry, follow this jam and vote.
jams_results_summary: {participants, plural, one {# participant} other {# participants}} · {voters, plural, one {# voter} other {# voters}}
jams_results_method: Scores are Bayesian averages. An entry needs at least {min} votes to be ranked.
jams_voting_rules: Only verified accounts at least {minDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old can vote, and never for their own entries.
jams_voting_hint: Vote counts stay hidden until the results are published. You can change your ratings until voting closes.
jams_follow_done: You'll get updates about this jam.
jams_unfollow_done: You no longer follow this jam.
jams_vote_blocked_email: Verify your email address to vote.
jams_vote_blocked_new: Your account is too new to vote in this jam.
jams_vote_blocked_activity: Take part in the community a little more to unlock voting.
jams_vote_blocked_phase: Voting is not open right now.
jams_vote_intro: Give 1 to 5 stars in each category. You can change your votes until voting closes.
jams_submit_intro: Pick one of your published mods or builds. You can withdraw it until submissions close.
jams_submit_none: You have no published mods or builds that can enter this jam yet.
jams_submit_notes_hint: Up to {max} characters. Tell people how it fits the theme.
jams_admin_description: Create and run Mod Jams: schedule, rules, categories, phases and entry moderation.
jams_admin_new_description: The jam starts as a draft with four default categories. Nothing is public until you announce it.
jams_admin_empty_text: Create the first Mod Jam to get started.
jams_admin_field_slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot be changed later.
jams_admin_error_title: The title needs at least 3 characters.
jams_admin_error_slug: Use at least 3 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
jams_editor_phase_description: Phases advance on their own following the schedule. Force a phase only to fix or accelerate things.
jams_editor_locked_text: The phase was forced by hand, so the schedule no longer moves it. Resume the schedule to hand control back.
jams_editor_force_text: Members who follow the jam are notified and the schedule stays paused until you resume it.
jams_editor_delete_text: Only drafts can be deleted. This cannot be undone.
jams_editor_theme_hint: Visible to staff only while it is hidden.
jams_editor_theme_hidden: Keep the theme secret until submissions open
jams_editor_banner_hint: An https:// link to an image, ideally 1600×600.
jams_editor_schedule_description: Times are in your browser's time zone and shown to everyone in UTC. Phases advance automatically at each moment.
jams_editor_auto_publish_hint: When voting closes, results are computed and published without review.
jams_editor_categories_description: Each category is rated 1 to 5 stars. The weight sets how much it counts towards the overall score.
jams_editor_categories_locked: Categories can't change once voting has started.
jams_editor_error_numbers: Check the numbers: entries 1 to 5, co-authors 0 to 10, age 0 to 365, activity 0 to 100 and votes 1 to 1000.
jams_editor_error_banner: The banner must be an https:// link.
jams_editor_error_categories: Each category needs a unique key (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; 2 to 31 characters).
jams_entries_admin_description: Entries appear publicly as soon as they are submitted. Hide or disqualify the ones that break the rules.
jams_entries_confirm_text: The entry leaves the gallery and its votes stop counting. You can restore it later.
jams_mine_description: Jams you can enter and the ones you have already taken part in.
jams_mine_open_empty_text: Follow a jam to hear when submissions open.
jams_mine_history_empty: You haven't entered a jam yet.
